messages.content: Draft an email response to a customer asking about account password reset

=== Email Draft Created ===
To: customer@example.com
Subject: Your Account Password Reset Request
Body:
Dear Customer,

Thank you for reaching out to us regarding your account password reset. 

To reset your password, please follow these steps:
1. Go to the login page and click on 'Forgot Password?'.
2. Enter the email address linked to your account.
3. You will receive an email with a link to reset your password.

If you have any trouble or need further assistance, please feel free to reply to this email.

Best regards,
Grace 
Support Engineer 
VibeTeam

Status: Draft created (simulated)
Note: In production, this would send via Gmail API/MCP
